nodes.name: core.rs
nodes.summary: Core implementation of the CSS rule tree, a structure that preserves selector matching results by organizing rules as a tree of StrongRuleNode/WeakRuleNode with refcounting, a free list, and generational GC for reuse of likely-to-match-again rules.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses unsafe Rust with atomic refcounting, manual free-list management, and pointer-based tree structures for lock-free concurrent access.

nodes.name: level.rs
nodes.summary: Defines CSS cascade level types including CascadeLevel (packed bitfield for origin, importance, and shadow cascade order), CascadeOrigin (UA/User/PresHints/Author/Animations/Transitions), and ShadowCascadeOrder for tracking shadow DOM rule nesting.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Rust bitflags for compact CascadeLevel representation packing origin (3 bits), importance (1 bit), shadow order (3 bits), and sign (1 bit) into a single u8.

nodes.name: map.rs
nodes.summary: Provides a space-optimized Map<K, V> data structure that starts as Empty, transitions to One for single-element storage, and grows into a full FxHashMap only when multiple entries are present, used for rule node children storage.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a three-state enum (Empty/One/Map) that avoids heap allocation for the common case of zero or one child per rule node.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the rule tree subsystem, re-exporting RuleTree, StrongRuleNode, CascadeLevel, CascadeOrigin, ShadowCascadeOrder, and StyleSource, and implementing high-level rule insertion, update, animation removal, and rule node querying methods.

nodes.name: source.rs
nodes.summary: Defines StyleSource, a wrapper around an Arc<Locked<PropertyDeclarationBlock>> representing the style source for a rule node, which may come from a style rule, animation, transition, SMIL, presentational hint, or style attribute.

nodes.name: unsafe_box.rs
nodes.summary: Provides UnsafeBox<T>, a manually-managed Box wrapper that suppresses Drop and allows unsafe operations like raw pointer cloning and manual drop for use in the rule tree's lock-free memory management.

nodes.name: RuleTree
nodes.summary: Root of the CSS rule tree structure that manages rule nodes with a free list and generational GC, providing the root node access and garbage collection methods.

nodes.name: RuleNode
nodes.summary: Internal node in the rule tree, storing a style source, cascade priority, parent/root pointers, atomic refcount, children map, and free list pointer. Forms the core data structure shared via StrongRuleNode and WeakRuleNode.

nodes.name: StrongRuleNode
nodes.summary: Public strong reference to a rule node, providing the primary API for rule tree traversal, child creation, style source access, debugging dump, and refcounted clone/drop semantics with free list integration.

nodes.name: CascadeLevel
nodes.summary: Packed bitfield representing CSS cascade level, encoding origin, importance, and shadow cascade order in a single u8. Provides comparison, importance toggling, and shadow root lookup methods.

nodes.name: CascadeOrigin
nodes.summary: Enum of CSS cascade origins in ascending precedence order: UA, User, PresHints, Author, PositionFallback, SMILOverride, Animations, Transitions with helper methods for origin simplification and guard selection.

nodes.name: ShadowCascadeOrder
nodes.summary: Signed integer wrapper (range -7 to 7) tracking how many shadow root rules deep a cascade level is, used for CSS scoping shadow cascading order resolution.

nodes.name: StyleSource
nodes.summary: Wrapper around Arc<Locked<PropertyDeclarationBlock>> representing the declaration block source for a rule node, providing read access, pointer equality comparison, and rule tree marking.

nodes.name: swap_free_list_and_gc
nodes.summary: Steals the free list from the root node, iterates all nodes in it, and drops those whose refcount reaches zero after decrementing, using acquire/release semantics for safe concurrent memory reclamation.

nodes.name: drop_without_free_list
nodes.summary: Drops a rule node bypassing the free list, removing it from its parent's children map under a write lock and recursively dropping ancestors whose refcount also reaches zero, preventing stack overflow from deep hierarchies.

nodes.name: push_on_free_list
nodes.summary: Atomically pushes a rule node onto the tree's shared free list using compare-exchange, incrementing the approximate free count and handling the case where the tree has been dropped.

nodes.name: ensure_child
nodes.summary: Looks up or creates a child rule node under the current node for a given style source and cascade priority, using upgradable read locks for concurrency and double-checked locking.

nodes.name: drop
nodes.summary: Drop implementation for StrongRuleNode that decrements the atomic refcount, and if reaching zero, pretends to be on the free list, pushes onto the free list, or falls through to drop_without_free_list for root or destroyed-tree cases.

nodes.name: cmp
nodes.summary: Orders CascadeLevel by importance (important rules override non-important, except transitions), then by origin and shadow cascade order, with origins reversed for important rules.

nodes.name: get_shadow_root_for_scoped
nodes.summary: Resolves the shadow root corresponding to a cascade level's shadow order for a given element, handling both inner (negative) and outer (positive) shadow tree traversal through slots.

nodes.name: entry
nodes.summary: Provides a hash-map-style entry API for the three-state Map, transitioning from Empty to One, or One to a full FxHashMap when a second entry is inserted, handling key equality via a closure.

nodes.name: insert_ordered_rules_with_important
nodes.summary: Inserts rules in specificity order while detecting and separating !important rules into author/user/UA buckets, then inserting them in increasing importance order after normal rules, followed by transition rules.

nodes.name: update_rule_at_level
nodes.summary: Replaces a rule at a given cascade level in an existing rule tree path, walking up to find the matching level, replacing the declaration block, and re-inserting child rules to build a new valid path.
